full_judgment: "Both the Courts below have found that the plaintiff's vendors were dispossessed in the year 1357 BS corresponding to 1950-1951 and the suit was filed in July 1966 long after the expiry of the 12 years. The suit was evidently time barred and the Courts below have rightly dismissed the suit."
